canonical.question: What specific-train restriction and different-date change deadline does the National Rail Off-Peak ticket guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: Off-Peak and Super Off-Peak tickets do not require you to travel on a specific train, only at certain times.
canonical.expected_secondary: If you need to travel on a different date, you will need to cancel your ticket and buy a new one before 23:59 on the day before travel.
canonical.tampered_primary: Off-Peak and Super Off-Peak tickets require travel on one named train only.
